order.df.label: directly followed by
order.df.comment: Relates an event to the event that directly follows it in a case trace. Superproperty of the directly-follows property of every case concept.
order.df.inverse_comment: Inverse of directly followed by. Relates an event to the event that directly precedes it in a case trace.

order.ef.label: eventually followed by
order.ef.comment: Relates an event to itself and to every later event in a case trace. Superproperty of the eventually-follows property of every case concept.
order.ef.inverse_comment: Inverse of eventually followed by. Relates an event to itself and to every earlier event in a case trace.

order.df_case.label: directly followed by ({case})
order.df_case.comment: Relates an event to the event that directly follows it in the same '{case}' trace.
order.df_case.inverse_comment: Inverse of directly followed by ({case}). Relates an event to the event that directly precedes it in the same '{case}' trace.

order.ef_case.label: eventually followed by ({case})
order.ef_case.comment: Relates an event to itself and to every later event in the same '{case}' trace.
order.ef_case.inverse_comment: Inverse of eventually followed by ({case}). Relates an event to itself and to every earlier event in the same '{case}' trace.

order.start.label: Start event ({case})
order.start.comment: Events with no predecessor in their '{case}' trace.

order.end.label: End event ({case})
order.end.comment: Events with no successor in their '{case}' trace.

attribute.property.label: has {original}
attribute.property.inverse_comment: Inverse of has {original}. Relates a '{original}' value to the {owners} carrying it.

attribute.bin_lowest.label: {original} ({types}): {bin}
attribute.bin_lowest.comment: Values of the '{original}' attribute of {owners} that are at most {high}.

attribute.bin.label: {original} ({types}): {bin}
attribute.bin.comment: Values of the '{original}' attribute of {owners} that are greater than {low} and at most {high}.

attribute.bin_highest.label: {original} ({types}): {bin}
attribute.bin_highest.comment: Values of the '{original}' attribute of {owners} that are greater than {low}.

declare.hierarchy.label: DECLARE constraint
declare.hierarchy.comment: Objects whose trace satisfies a DECLARE constraint mined from the log. Each subclass is one constraint and holds the objects that satisfy it.

declare.constraint.label: {constraint}
declare.constraint.comment: Objects whose trace satisfies the DECLARE constraint '{constraint}'.

change.class.label: {original} change
change.class.comment: Records of the '{original}' attribute taking a new value.

change.property.label: changes {original} to
change.property.comment: Relates a change record to the new '{original}' value.
change.property.inverse_comment: Inverse of changes {original} to. Relates a '{original}' value to the change records that set it.
